item.title: OCaml Weekly News, 27 Oct 2026
item.description:
1. uniker.nl - Unikernels in OCaml
  2. Announcing segmap, a fast data structure for renamings
  3. hexen.0.1
  4. intel_hex.1.0
  5. Js_of_ocaml / Wasm_of_ocaml 6.5
  6. TIFF Inspector: an ocaml-tiff based inspector, with an in-browser OCaml playground
  7. OCaml 5.5.2 released
  8. bytream.0.4
  9. First release of spvec
  10. ocaml-emcc: compile OCaml programs with their C stubs to WebAssembly
  11. New release of snkv-ocaml 0.3.0 — OCaml bindings for SNKV with HNSW vector search
  12. Building TIFF Inspector: Exploring OCaml, TIFF Internals, and an In-Browser Playground
  13. stele 0.1.0: syntax-error messages for Menhir grammars
  14. OSEC-2026-21: Str partial-match stale capture registers underflow
  15. OSEC-2026-22: Integer overflow in Unix.map_file
  16. OSEC-2026-23: Multiple issues in Marshal
  17. OSEC-2026-24: Multiple issues in command quoting on Windows
  18. OSEC-2026-25: Heap buffer overflow in the OCaml ~runtime_events~ consumer when parsing an oversized custom user event
  19. OSEC-2026-26: runtime_events user event name-based type confusion
